method: Manual inspection and interaction through the Codex in-app browser against the local research artifacts.
checks: Report title, typography, diacritics, contents navigation, morphology table and Kalkoti comparison table visually inspected; 12 sections and 16 narrative tables; document width equals the 1280-pixel viewport.
Family explorer contains 1686 dossiers. Exact family 10702 yields one dossier; expanded analysis uses the full card width and includes all seven language panels.
Exact record f_526agso5rjzf6 yields one analysis token and displays its source assessment and supplementary skin etymology.
Unlinked view contains 13272 analysis tokens; Ushojo filter yields 328 tokens and advances correctly from page 1 to page 2. These are token counts, distinct from raw-record counts.
Record review filters are disabled in family view, avoiding a misleading inactive filter.
Quantitative appendix exposes 43 tables. The class-definition table contains 27 domains. The i-declension extension contains 43 rows and exact thupéek search retains the excluded paradigm.
Complete-row expansion preserves all 14 fields of the gun example; table and document fit the desktop viewport without page-level clipping.
Source register visually inspected with formatted bibliographies, full language names and explicit source-access caveats.
Five supplementary etymology proposals visually inspected; source evidence, accent consequences, confidence and further tests are present.
No JavaScript console errors observed in the inspected appendix pages.
scope: Presentation changes and expanded counterpart joins use the frozen analytical inventories. No additional phonological laws or lexical assignments were introduced after the 11:55:44 UTC analytical freeze.
limitations: This is targeted desktop browser QA, not a claim that every expanded raw-record field or every remote primary-source URL was interactively opened.
